import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path = Path('results/expansion/mistral_default_plan.json')
command = ['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'nim', '.venv/bin/python', '-u',
           'scripts/expand_nim.py', '--models', 'mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b',
           '--protocol-file', 'protocol-mistral-default.json']
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'one compatibility control for the documented Mistral request rejected with HTTP 400'}, 'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'command': command,
          'status': 'waiting_for_additional_batch_and_gpt_resume',
          'prior_failure_protocol': 'results/expansion/protocol-additional.json',
          'documentation': 'https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/mistralai-mistral-large-4-1t-a52b-infer',
          'change': 'Omit reasoning_effort. Official schema says an omitted field is served as none; the explicit none request returns HTTP 400. Preserve both labels/caches and failures, and do not presume the actual server mode is equivalent without response evidence.',
          'controls': 'Same validation availability prompt, temperature 0.3, max_tokens 4096, timeout 600, three attempts, one request under the NIM mutex. If usable, the fixed 200/game test uses seeds 200-399. No test score selects this field.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
while json.loads(Path('results/expansion/additional_followup_plan.json').read_text())['status'] != 'finished':
    time.sleep(10)
record.update(status='acquiring_slot_then_running',
              prior_protocol_sha256=file_sha256('results/expansion/protocol-additional.json'))
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
result = subprocess.run(command)
record.update(status='finished', exit_code=result.returncode)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
